image-only-editorial.prompt_prefix: IMAGE ONLY. Create only the underlying photograph or illustration. Do not create a magazine cover, poster, advertisement, slide, infographic, interface mockup, caption, headline, logo, watermark, typography, letters, words, numbers, signage, or graphic-design overlay unless the brief explicitly requires visible text. Publication typography will be added separately.
acceptance_criteria: No unintended text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, or publication-layout overlays.
No obvious anatomy or object-geometry defects at normal viewing size.
Composition serves the brief and leaves intentional usable negative space when the brief calls for it.
Visual style matches the requested editorial/photographic/illustrative intent rather than drifting into a generic slide or infographic.
No obvious low-quality, broken, duplicated, or incoherent elements.
retry_guidance: If rejected for accidental typography or layout, strengthen image-only language and regenerate with a new seed.
If two quality attempts fail for aesthetics or composition, use the configured fallback role rather than continuing indefinitely.

image-only-precision.prompt_prefix: IMAGE ONLY. Render the requested scene and spatial relationships precisely. Do not add any text, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signs, labels, captions, UI chrome, infographic panels, magazine-cover treatment, or layout overlays unless visible text is explicitly required by the brief.
acceptance_criteria: Required objects, counts, spatial relationships, and scene constraints are present and coherent.
No unintended text, typography, UI panels, logos, watermarks, labels, or infographic layout.
No obvious anatomy, perspective, or object-geometry defects.
The image remains visually usable as publication artwork rather than becoming a slide or diagram unless that was explicitly requested.
retry_guidance: For semantic errors, make relationships and object counts more explicit and regenerate with a new seed.
For repeated accidental typography, use the configured fallback role after the bounded quality loop.

acceptance_criteria: Every requested visible word is spelled correctly and readable at intended display size.
No extra invented words, pseudo-text, or unrelated labels are present.
Typography hierarchy and placement match the brief.
Image composition remains coherent around the requested text.
retry_guidance: Reject any output with misspelled or pseudo-text; regenerate rather than repairing downstream unless the text will be added separately.

editing.prompt_prefix: Perform only the requested edit while preserving unrelated composition, identity, lighting, background, and geometry as closely as possible unless the brief explicitly asks to change them.
acceptance_criteria: The requested change is present.
Unrequested regions and identity-defining features remain materially consistent with the source image.
Reference-image attributes are transferred only where requested.
No new unintended text, logos, watermarks, anatomy defects, or composition drift appear.
retry_guidance: If the edit changes unrelated regions, narrow the instruction and retry with the same source/reference set using a new seed.
After repeated drift, stop and surface the failure instead of silently accepting a materially changed image.

acceptance_criteria: Composition and identity remain consistent with the accepted source image.
No invented text, facial changes, geometry drift, halos, or excessive artificial texture are introduced.
The higher-resolution result is materially useful at the target display/crop size.
retry_guidance: If restoration invents detail, reduce softness or keep the accepted source instead of forcing an upscale.
